subject: ext-f
title: (R)EXT.F.------AF.DY.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 37 (WM-13). EXT-F (extended functionalism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics), AFTD (affinity tendencies), DY-SPI and POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From CULT-INFO-DY: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and AFL (affinity alignment). From AFL: RT-T. From POST: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance).
